text:
lina: kicking off an integration run for the FlashAttention v3 selector+fallback. want to validate kernel selection heuristics, batching behavior, and kv-cache interactions before we open the flag to broader traffic. canary plan below — looking for owners and quick sanity checks. :eyes:

mike: thanks — basic ask: reproduce the perf matrix for short/medium/long seqs, and verify we don't regress p99 under mixed-batch load. i'll own the harness runs.

anya: i'll add KV-cache telemetry probes. saw weird tail spikes last time when cache hit rate dropped below ~60%. need to confirm whether selector is preferring flashv3 for cases where paged fallback would be better.

sam: FYI ops perspective: canary must have auto-fallback to flashv2 on either latency or error-rate triggers. suggest these thresholds: p99 > baseline + 15ms for 5min OR error_rate > 0.5%. fallback should be immediate and throttle ramp.

lina: agreed. proposed rollout: 1) alpha internal (0.5% rps) for 1 hour, 2) canary (5%) for 2 hours, 3) ramp to 25% over 1h if stable. auto-fallback rules per @sam above.

mike: starting a perf job now. command i'm using: ```bash
./tools/perf/run_attn_bench \
  --model=gpt2-medium \
  --seqs=128,512,2048 \
  --batch=1,8,32 \
  --kernel=selector:flashv3,flashv2 \
  --kv-sim=true \
  --warmups=50 --iters=300
```

perf-bot: perf job 4309876543 started (id=perf.4310). collecting per-kernel p50/p95/p99, batch-util, kv-hit-rate, and gpu-util telemetry. will post summary when complete.

mike: early smoke (shortseq, batch=8): flashv3 p99 ~7.4ms vs flashv2 ~9.1ms (win). medium seq (512) batch=32: flashv3 p99 ~28ms vs flashv2 ~25ms (regression) — looks correlated with cache eviction churn. attaching raw snippet: ```
[run id=4310] seq=512 batch=32 kernel=flashv3 p99=28.2ms kv_hit=58% gpu_util=92%
[run id=4310] seq=512 batch=32 kernel=flashv2 p99=25.0ms kv_hit=58% gpu_util=92%
```

anya: that aligns with my local profiling. when kv_hit < ~65% flashv3's memory-access pattern causes slightly higher tail due to extra per-block synchronization in our current v3 kernel path. paging + big batches amplify it.

lina: important callout — we need selector heuristics to consider kv_hit_rate estimate + batch size. current selector only uses seq_len and batch. propose a short-term rule: if kv_hit_est < 0.65 AND batch >= 16 AND seq >= 256 => prefer flashv2. can we add that as a feature-flagged heuristic?

dev-bot: created PR #8423: "selector: add kv_hit heuristic + ff flag". CI passed for unit tests. ready for integration testing.

sam: add a guard so the selector exposes a telemetry tag when it chooses flashv3 despite low kv_hit_est — that'll make it easier to search in the data plane.

anya: also adding a microbenchmark to simulate kv-miss churn: small prefix variations to blow the cache. mike, can you run `--kv-sim=burst` variant?

mike: running burst now. early results: flashv3 p99 increases to ~42ms for seq=2048 batch=8 when kv-sim=burst and gpu_util spikes. logs: ```
[run id=4310] seq=2048 batch=8 kernel=flashv3 kv_sim=burst p99=42.1ms kv_hit=42%
[run id=4310] seq=2048 batch=8 kernel=flashv2 kv_sim=burst p99=36.7ms kv_hit=42%
```

lina: rough takeaway: flashv3 wins for short sequences and well-cached workloads; flashv2 still wins on heavy-kv-miss long sequences. selector must be conservative in low-cache scenarios.

mike: perf-bot summary will be posted in ~20m. once we have numbers i'll open a canary deployment with the ff flag `ff_new_flashv3_selector` set to _alpha_, routed to 0.5% rps.

ops-bot: scheduled canary window: today 16:00-19:00 UTC. alert hooks: #incidents, eng-runtime oncall. rollback playbook: /runbooks/attn-kernel-rollback.md

lina: action items:
- mike: post full perf matrix, include kv_hit histograms and p99 deltas (owner)
- anya: add kv telemetry tag and microbenchmark for kv-burst (owner)
- sam: codify fallback thresholds in rollout config (owner)
- dev-bot: gate PR to protect flag (owner)

mike: noted — will post artifacts under artifacts/perf/4310 and link here when done.

perf-bot: perf job 4309876543 completed. summary: shortseq (128) flashv3 +14% p50, -17% p99 vs v2; medium (512) mixed: avg +6% p50, p99 regression +12ms when kv_hit < 65%; longseq (2048) with kv-burst: flashv3 p99 +14% vs v2. attaching CSV to artifacts/perf/4310/summary.csv

anya: updated selector PR to include telemetry tag and added unit for kv_est computation. PR link: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/8423

sam: rollout config proposal posted to infra repo: `infra/rollouts/flashv3_selector.yaml` with thresholds and canary percent. please review before canary window.

lina: if no objections within next hour i'll flip the alpha flag and start the 0.5% internal run. will monitor p99 and error_rate closely. ping @mike @anya when ready. :rocket:

mike: ready on my side. will watch and be standing by to cut traffic if metrics cross thresholds.

anya: standing by for telemetry dashboards to populate. added dashboard widgets: kv_hit_rate, kernel_choice, per-kernel p99 by seq bin.

lina: perfect. thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after the canary to decide on ramp or adjusting heuristics. :thumbsup:
